config.objective: source-balanced mean final value divided by fractional upper bound

holdout_manifest.dependence_notice: New canonical knapsack combinations reuse the original test-source dates and may reuse source rows/invoices. This is an instance holdout, not an independent business sample.
holdout_manifest.source_pool: original test partition only; whole-invoice earliest-date 70/15/15 chronological split

evaluation.timing: Warmed CPU, one torch thread, single-instance solver calls including context and solution construction; excludes I/O and DP. Portfolio reruns all eight; guard reruns greedy if needed.

protocol.action_counts: observed raw-method decisions; no invented action for descriptive mean rows
protocol.bootstrap: paired percentile 95% sampling CI conditional on fitted models; real whole dates across cells, synthetic instances within family/n/alpha cells; equal source means each draw
protocol.feasibility: all selected sets independently reconstructed; malformed/infeasible rows stop reporting before any output
protocol.interval_sign: candidate exact gap minus reference exact gap; negative favors candidate
protocol.random: 10-trial arithmetic mean per instance, never best-of-ten; all per-trial timings retained
protocol.regret: 100*(V_portfolio_best-V)/V*, in percentage points; portfolio comprises eight arms and excludes DQN seeds 1/2
protocol.seed_means: arithmetic mean of per-instance seed metrics; W/T/L rates average per-seed comparisons; latency pools original single-run observations
protocol.seed_sd: sample SD (ddof=1) of the three source-balanced model estimates, separate from sampling CI
protocol.timing: saved empirical single-instance construction timings; no simulated or inferred timing; portfolio and guarded costs are taken from evaluator
protocol.trivial: zero-optimum cases counted but excluded from percentage denominators; undefined whole-source denominators stay undefined
protocol.weighting: equal source means separately within each split/group; synthetic-only E4
